Data_Storage.title: How the Data are Stored
Data_Storage.description: In the world of software, trust is built on knowing where your data lives. Orchestra Sync treats your data with two distinct levels of residence.

How_It_Works.title: How It Works
How_It_Works.description: So, how does the magic happen? Let's peek behind the curtain. Orchestra Sync functions as a translator and a courier between Figma and GitHub.

How_To_Set_Up.title: How to Set Up Your Settings
How_To_Set_Up.description: Setting up Orchestra Sync is a one-time ritual to bind your design file to your code repository. Think of it as tuning your instrument before the concert.

Prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
Prerequisites.description: Before you can begin conducting your design system with Orchestra Sync, you must ensure the stage is set. There are a few non-negotiable requirements.

Supported_Features.title: Supported Features
Supported_Features.description: Orchestra Sync is built to handle the core building blocks of a modern Design System. Here is what it supports out of the box.

Things_To_Take_Care.title: Things to Take Care Of (Best Practices)
Things_To_Take_Care.description: With great power comes great responsibility. Orchestra Sync allows you to change production code from a design tool. Here is how to do it safely.

Unsupported_Features.title: Limitations (What is Not Supported)
Unsupported_Features.description: To use a tool effectively, you must know its boundaries. Here are the things Orchestra Sync does not currently handle.

What_Is_This_Plugin.title: What is Orchestra Sync?
What_Is_This_Plugin.description: Imagine a world where the wall between Design and Development crumbles down. That is the world Orchestra Sync builds for you.
